name: Atapuerca (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, yellow, green, white and blue, the green broadest, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Atapuerca (a castle, a saltire and a mountain).
history: Municipal flag of Atapuerca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Atapuerca arms — castle, saltire and mountain
